title: Building Custom Kinetic Models
text: rumen gas production studies rely predefined set kinetic models. However, researchers often wish : Test novel equations Compare alternative model structures Develop new biological interpretations Reproduce models literature rumenGP provides fit_custom() fitting user-defined nonlinear kinetic models. Custom models integrate directly : summary() plot_fit() plot_residuals() compare_models() vignette demonstrates build, fit, evaluate custom models.
code: library(rumenGP)

title: Building Custom Kinetic Models
text: Create simple gas-production dataset. Convert rumen_gp object.
code: manual_volume <- data.frame(    Bottle = c(     rep(1, 10),     rep(2, 10)   ),    Treatment = c(     rep("Control", 10),     rep("Corn", 10)   ),    Time = rep(     c(       0, 2, 4, 6, 8,       12, 16, 24, 36, 48     ),     2   ),    Gas = c(      0, 5, 12, 20, 28,     40, 55, 75, 90, 100,      0, 8, 18, 30, 42,     58, 72, 95, 110, 120    )  ) gp <- as_rumen_gp(   data = manual_volume,   head_col = "Bottle",   treatment_col = "Treatment",   time_col = "Time",   gas_col = "Gas" )

title: Building Custom Kinetic Models
text: Consider equation: Gas(t)=(1−e−kt) Gas(t) = \left( 1 - e^{-kt} \right) : = asymptotic gas production k = fractional rate constant Fit model: Inspect results: Estimated parameters:
code: exp_fit <- fit_custom(    data = gp,    formula =     Gas_mL ~       A *       (         1 -           exp(             -k * Time_h           )       ),    start = list(     A = 120,     k = 0.05   ),    lower = c(     A = 0,     k = 0   ),    model_name =     "Simple Exponential"  ) #> rumenGP data validation passed. #> Observations: 20 #> Heads: 2 #> Treatments: 2 summary(exp_fit) #>  #> Custom model summary #> -------------------- #> Model name: Simple Exponential #>  #> Formula: #> Gas_mL ~ A * (1 - exp(-k * Time_h)) #>  #> Total bottles: 2 #> Successful fits: 2 #> Failed fits: 0 #> Mean R-squared: 0.9948 #> Mean RMSE: 2.6455 #> Mean AIC: 53.8257 #> Mean BIC: 54.7335 exp_fit$parameters #>   Head Bottle Rep Treatment        A          k #> 1    1      1   1   Control 129.5045 0.03253995 #> 2    2      2   1      Corn 137.3987 0.04521177

title: Building Custom Kinetic Models
text: Consider: Gas(t)=(tt+K) Gas(t) = \left( \frac{t} { t + K } \right) : = asymptotic gas production K = half-time parameter Fit model: Inspect results:
code: hyperbolic_fit <- fit_custom(    data = gp,    formula =     Gas_mL ~       A *       (         Time_h /         (           Time_h + K         )       ),    start = list(     A = 150,     K = 10   ),    lower = c(     A = 0,     K = 0   ),    model_name =     "Hyperbolic"  ) #> rumenGP data validation passed. #> Observations: 20 #> Heads: 2 #> Treatments: 2 summary(hyperbolic_fit) #>  #> Custom model summary #> -------------------- #> Model name: Hyperbolic #>  #> Formula: #> Gas_mL ~ A * (Time_h/(Time_h + K)) #>  #> Total bottles: 2 #> Successful fits: 2 #> Failed fits: 0 #> Mean R-squared: 0.9922 #> Mean RMSE: 3.2766 #> Mean AIC: 58.101 #> Mean BIC: 59.0087 hyperbolic_fit$parameters #>   Head Bottle Rep Treatment        A        K #> 1    1      1   1   Control 204.2057 46.74889 #> 2    2      2   1      Corn 201.8404 30.30936

title: Building Custom Kinetic Models
text: Richards model flexible four-parameter sigmoidal equation. Gas(t)=VF(1−−kt)m Gas(t) = VF \left( 1 - b e^{-kt} \right)^m : VF = maximum gas production b = interaction constant k = fractional rate constant m = shape parameter Fit model: Review diagnostics: Review parameter estimates:
code: richards_fit <- fit_custom(    data = gp,    formula =     Gas_mL ~       VF *       (         1 -           b *           exp(             -k * Time_h           )       )^m,    start = list(     VF = max(gp$Gas_mL) * 1.1,     b = 0.9,     k = 0.05,     m = 1   ),    lower = c(     VF = 0,     b = 0,     k = 0,     m = 0   ),    upper = c(     VF = Inf,     b = 1,     k = Inf,     m = 10   ),    model_name =     "Richards"  ) #> rumenGP data validation passed. #> Observations: 20 #> Heads: 2 #> Treatments: 2 richards_fit$diagnostics #>   Head Bottle Rep Treatment Converged     Status      RSS        R2      RMSE #> 1    1      1   1   Control      TRUE         OK 6.803655 0.9994155 0.8248427 #> 2    2      2   1      Corn     FALSE FIT_FAILED       NA        NA        NA #>        AIC      BIC #> 1 34.52752 36.04044 #> 2       NA       NA richards_fit$parameters #>   Head Bottle Rep Treatment       VF         b         k        m #> 1    1      1   1   Control 107.5372 0.9842168 0.0622272 1.502899 #> 2    2      2   1      Corn       NA        NA        NA       NA
